heroes.dev_note: Lúcio’s Wall Ride allowed him to reach unintended places in Capture the Flag maps, which made it overly difficult for opponents to stop him. So, we have changed the ability to cause the flag to drop instead for better balanced matches.

changes.text_en: Activating Wall Ride will now cause the flag to drop during Capture the Flag matches

blocks.title: General
blocks.body:
- Fixed a typo that caused the Lunar New Year banner to display the wrong end date for Overwatch Lunar New Year
- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the client to crash after a player used the Hero Skin Selection dropdown menu in Hero Select

blocks.title: Capture the Flag
blocks.body:
- Fixed a bug that allowed Winston to pick up the flag while airborne after activating his Jump Pack
- Fixed a bug that caused flags dropped near ceilings to get stuck inside of walls

blocks.title: Deathmatch
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that caused Mei to levitate if she used Cryo-stasis

blocks.title: Game Browser and Custom Games
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that prevented players from playing games in the Arcade if they were using a trial account

blocks.title: Heroes
blocks.body:
- Fixed a bug that caused hero ultimate charges to reset after the first death if a player changed their skin using the Hero Skin Selection a second before the match began
- Fixed a bug that caused Zarya’s reaction animations to loop continuously after taking damage following the destruction of her Particle Barrier

blocks.title: UI
blocks.body: - Fixed a bug that prevented the Weekly Rewards timer in from displaying correctly in the Arcade
